summary_md: **Mohak Bajaj ([@MohakBajaj5](https://x.com/MohakBajaj5/status/2116132009169056057))** lists sandboxes for coding agents from light to heavy: Anthropic's sandbox-runtime, bubblewrap, wasmtime, gVisor, Kata Containers, Firecracker, microsandbox, E2B and Cloudflare's sandbox SDK ([anthropics/sandbox-runtime](https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime), [containers/bubblewrap](http://github.com/containers/bubblewrap), [google/gvisor](http://github.com/google/gvisor), [firecracker-microvm/firecracker](http://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - anthropics/sandbox-runtime: A lightweight sandboxing tool for enforcing filesystem and network restrictions on arbitrary processes at the OS level, without requiring a container.

relevance: Reference list for isolating agent execution.
